name: Babice (Prague-East District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a navy blue hoist half and a green fly half, with a crowned yellow dragon rampant with red tongue and a small white Maltese cross below it.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 21 September 2005 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
